Use it only when several people measured the same object at the same time; for a single witness use identif

Use it for 'what if' questions; for real asteroids passing today use neo_watch. Local mod

tools.name: hawking_black_hole
tools.description: Compute a black hole of any mass: event-horizon radius, Hawking temperature, entropy and evaporation time. Use it for physics questions about black holes; give exactly one of mass_kg, mass_solar or preset. Exact formulas, computed locally, no network call.

tools.description: Step 1 of 2: prepare a draft report of something seen in the sky, without publishing or sending anything. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "draft_sighting_report" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: iss_passes, nearby_cases, sky_events · Private data: doctrine, first_skies, capabilities, eclipse_2027, draft_sighting_report · Public sink: nasa_apod, submit_sighting_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: iss_passes, nearby_cases, sky_events · Private data: doctrine, first_skies, capabilities, eclipse_2027, draft_sighting_report · Public sink: nasa_apod, submit_sighting_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
